method: Used FFmpeg to extract actual frames at the listed times from the final MP4s, then visually inspected both resulting 1920x720 PNGs.
observations: Main kitten fur and facial features remain clear alongside the two static companion cats.
The held star sits between the cupped paws, and the released star remains separate from the scarf clasp and eyes.
The cat9 mark, real mew/九喵 text and tagline remain readable in both encoded samples.
No obvious frame clipping, opaque character rectangles, or disconnected supporting paws were observed in these samples.
scope: Two static samples from encoded MP4s. Full decode is separately recorded; this does not claim continuous human artistic approval or user acceptance.
